# River by Asynarch

AI-native bank reconciliation that fuses your accountant and your accounting software.

## Value Proposition
- **Fuses Software and Service:** River is not a tool you learn, nor an accountant you hire. It handles the back-office matching work automatically and flags only what needs your eye.
- **Reconciliation Engine:** Automatically matches bank statements (PDFs) and general ledgers (spreadsheets), drafts the Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS), and categorizes transactions.
- **Focus on Business, Not Bookkeeping:** River automates the back-office overhead so leaders can focus on building the business instead of managing the bank ledger.

## Key Product Features
- **Audit Console Simulator:** A conversational audit feed showing file ingestion, automated transaction matching, discrepancy alerts (e.g. missing receipts, duplicate billing), and user sign-offs.
- **Final Signer Promise:** Only perfect matches go through automatically. Any anomaly is flagged for human review.
- **Automation Vision:** Moving beyond reconciliation to automate the entire back-office (matching, reconciling, chasing, closing).
